title: Record conditional M11 private promotion authorization and observe installed calendar policy

contribution.value: Reuse existing archive and rollback verification. The installed read-only planner must observe both layouts and exact version history on the versions' encoded date. Report each exact candidate match or blocker, including nonzero observations, without allocating, publishing, rebuilding or numerically requalifying either package. Preserve M11 completion and the M12 readiness frontier.

Use the installed planner instead of duplicating or bypassing calendar and mixed-layout policy.
Treat a successfully recorded BLOCKED verdict as a completed observation, not permission to publish either package.
